{"people":[{"name":"Elena","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Stefan","role":"new head of payments at the customer; recommended the change","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineering manager","role":"originally bought us; ran payments before Stefan; left last year","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO","role":"approved the decision per Stefan","side":"customer"},{"name":"Payments performance team","role":"our team that produced the market-by-market analysis","side":"us"},{"name":"Adyen","role":"competitor that ran the test on international traffic","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":"Stripe (us): the customer was an existing Stripe account up for renewal",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"A new head of payments. Stefan. They'd never had one.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"New role at the customer started the evaluation."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Payments sat under an engineering manager, the guy who originally bought us, and he left last year.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Original buyer and champion gone a year before the evaluation."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"the first thing he did was pull declines by country","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Stefan's first action was a declines-by-country analysis."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"A few of their international markets looked bad to him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's characterization of Stefan's view of the data."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He mentioned Brazil and a couple in Europe.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Only market names given; rep admits not knowing exactly."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"I never saw his analysis.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Rep never saw the customer's data behind the trigger."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Stefan recommended it and the CFO approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Decision path: Stefan recommends, CFO approves."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"this went to the CFO two weeks ago.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Stefan's own statement of timing; sent to CFO two weeks before the last call."},
{"id":"E9","turn":10,"excerpt":"Adyen ran a test on a slice of their international traffic and came back with results by country.","label":"fact","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Reported by Stefan: Adyen proved itself with a country-level test."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"local acquiring","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Phrase Stefan kept using for what Adyen offered."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"I can't tell you what the test showed. He wouldn't share it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Test results unknown to us."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"They got very specific. What's our approval rate in this country, on this card type, by issuer. And why.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Customer questions shifted to granular, customer-specific approval data after meeting Adyen."},
{"id":"E13","turn":14,"excerpt":"The Authorization Boost deck. The average uplift customers see.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our answer was a generic average-uplift deck."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"that's an average. What's mine?","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer rejected the average and asked for his own numbers."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"I can't take an average to my CFO.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Needs customer-specific proof for CFO."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"It's a renewal, so we weren't really pitching.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep deflects the pitch-reaction question."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"They like the product. The developers love us, billing works, nobody wanted to rip anything out.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","outcome"],"note":"Rep's read on product satisfaction."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"That's why the US stayed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's explanation for why US volume stayed; only part moved."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"Silence was the uplift number, like I said.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The uplift number got no traction."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"I offered a roadmap session and he didn't take it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Customer declined the roadmap offer."},
{"id":"E21","turn":18,"excerpt":"I don't think there was a moment. It was kind of decided before we got in the room.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's theory; hedged and conflicts with later details."},
{"id":"E22","turn":18,"excerpt":"I'm not sure there was anything to do.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Rep claims nothing could have been done."},
{"id":"E23","turn":20,"excerpt":"When the renewal notice went out and Stefan replied asking to split the contract.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","outcome"],"note":"Rep learned of evaluation only at renewal; customer asked to split."},
{"id":"E24","turn":22,"excerpt":"Before I took the account. So nine months? Ten.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Last business review was 9-10 months earlier, hedged."},
{"id":"E25","turn":22,"excerpt":"It was a healthy account. Growing, no tickets. It wasn't on anybody's list.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's view that account was not at risk."},
{"id":"E26","turn":24,"excerpt":"No. I knew the engineering manager had left. I didn't know they'd hired a head of payments.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"No prior contact with Stefan; rep unaware of the new role."},
{"id":"E27","turn":26,"excerpt":"A market-by-market view of their own approval rates, with reasons.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"What the customer asked for that we could not show at first."},
{"id":"E28","turn":26,"excerpt":"Our payments performance team did a proper analysis.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"We could produce the analysis."},
{"id":"E29","turn":26,"excerpt":"But that landed three weeks after he asked, and by then the test was finished.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Our analysis arrived late, after Adyen's test ended."},
{"id":"E30","turn":26,"excerpt":"He asked who at Stripe looks at his numbers every month, and I didn't have a name.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer wanted a named person; we had none."},
{"id":"E31","turn":28,"excerpt":"Real findings. Things we could have fixed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Analysis showed fixable issues."},
{"id":"E32","turn":28,"excerpt":"He said it was the most useful thing we'd sent him.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Reported not verbatim; Stefan valued the analysis."},
{"id":"E33","turn":30,"excerpt":"Money left on the table.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Stefan's headline for his problem."},
{"id":"E34","turn":30,"excerpt":"Local cards, local rails.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","competitor"],"note":"Stefan's framing of the solution."},
{"id":"E35","turn":30,"excerpt":"what's mine","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"Repeated demand for customer-specific numbers."},
{"id":"E36","turn":30,"excerpt":"He doesn't say 'authorization,' he says 'approvals.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer vocabulary differs from our product naming."},
{"id":"E37","turn":30,"excerpt":"I heard from Stripe when I said I was leaving.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Customer felt we engaged only when he threatened to leave."},
{"id":"E38","turn":32,"excerpt":"They went with local acquiring.","label":"fact","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","competitor"],"note":"Outcome: customer moved to local acquiring, at least for international."},
{"id":"E39","turn":32,"excerpt":"I don't know what I'd have pitched against that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Elena","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Rep lacks a response to local acquiring."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8","E21"],"what":"Rep says it was decided before we got in the room, but Stefan said it went to the CFO only two weeks before the last call, after the evaluation."},
{"evidence":["E21","E22","E29","E31","E37"],"what":"Rep says no moment and nothing to do, yet our analysis had fixable findings, arrived three weeks late, and Stefan said he heard from Stripe only when leaving."},
{"evidence":["E25","E24","E26","E30"],"what":"Rep calls it a healthy account off anyone's list, yet no business review for 9-10 months, no contact with Stefan, unaware of the new role, and no named contact."},
{"evidence":["E16","E13"],"what":"Rep says we weren't really pitching, but we answered with the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance."},
{"evidence":["E39","E31","E32"],"what":"Rep says she doesn't know what she'd have pitched, yet our analysis had real, fixable findings and Stefan called it the most useful thing we'd sent."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which ones? (which international markets looked bad)","turn":4,"what":"Said 'I don't know exactly' and never saw the analysis."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":16,"what":"Deflected with 'it's a renewal, so we weren't really pitching' and generic praise before naming silence."},
{"question":"When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?","turn":18,"what":"Said there was no moment and nothing to do, later contradicted by late analysis, fixable findings, and Stefan's remark."},
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":10,"what":"Couldn't say what the Adyen test showed; Stefan wouldn't share it."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"approvals","ours":"authorization (Authorization Boost)","evidence":["E36","E13"]},
{"theirs":"what's mine","ours":"the average uplift customers see","evidence":["E35","E14","E13"]},
{"theirs":"local cards, local rails / local acquiring","ours":"Adaptive Acceptance, the machine learning piece","evidence":["E34","E10","E13"]},
{"theirs":"money left on the table","ours":"uplift","evidence":["E33","E19"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E38"],"what":"Customer went with local acquiring, so the international business was lost."},
{"evidence":["E23"],"what":"Stefan asked to split the contract at renewal, signalling a partial move."},
{"evidence":["E18","E17"],"what":"US business stayed with us; only international moved, so a partial loss."},
{"evidence":["E7","E8"],"what":"CFO approved Stefan's recommendation, which went to the CFO two weeks before the last call."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says it was decided before we got in the room, but Stefan said it went to the CFO only two weeks before the last call, after the evaluation.
Rep says no moment and nothing to do, yet our analysis had fixable findings, arrived three weeks late, and Stefan said he heard from Stripe only when leaving.
Rep calls it a healthy account off anyone's list, yet no business review for 9-10 months, no contact with Stefan, unaware of the new role, and no named contact.
Rep says we weren't really pitching, but we answered with the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance.
Rep says she doesn't know what she'd have pitched, yet our analysis had real, fixable findings and Stefan called it the most useful thing we'd sent.
